test_apply_to_tensors: test the apply_to_tensors function that recursively applies a callable to all tensors in nested containers
test_pack_kwargs: test the pack_kwargs function that flattens positional and keyword arguments into separate key and value tuples
test_unpack_kwargs: test the unpack_kwargs function that reconstructs positional args and kwargs dict from packed key and value tuples
test_split_non_tensors: test the split_non_tensors function that separates tensors from non-tensor objects in a tuple for later reconstruction
test_packed_sequence: test that apply_to_tensors correctly modifies PyTorch RNN PackedSequence objects by filling tensor data with zeros
